authority: Frozen reviewed local 119 source snapshots; not an upstream complete official reproduction

behavior_differences: Numerical initialization and legacy all-view vote denominator retained.
Add explicit vote-policy rejection, known out-of-FOV limitation and audit fields; no visibility correction.
Completion marker no longer requests human review; initialization equations are unchanged.
Keep numerical 119 training schedule and renderer unchanged; remove optional manual checkpoint callback and pending-review status.
Preserve legacy behavior when pixel convention is undeclared.
Extract the 119 renderer-corner to detector-integer conversion into CPU-testable camera_intrinsics_for_prior using float32 arithmetic.
Minimal mask_margin_4px support transplanted into the existing main fitter; legacy remains default.
Later optional anatomical z-buffer branch deliberately not transplanted; 119 configuration uses none.
Port proper-rotation roundoff normalization, nearest-scene-axis export and actual result step count.
Disable PLY memory mapping to release file handles for Windows candidate validation/renaming.

119 static_clothed_world exports common 3DGS cameras.json and COLMAP PINHOLE text; original private records/world_to_viewer move to optional camera_provenance.json. Legacy formal-route camera manifest is unchanged.
119 export emits standard model/cameras and numerical validation only; no HTML review page or 36-view UI preview. Legacy bound-route output remains unchanged.
Byte-for-byte lightweight mask-support helper; missing from the historical snapshot but required by its configured fitter.
Portable fresh-video/assets/output interface; no learned subject state is reused.
One uninterrupted 119 run through 18000 steps and generic export; no manual review commands, decisions or checkpoint waiting.
Numerical fit, surface, training and PLY parity checks remain enforced; completion does not claim physical accuracy.
One-time GPU/model configuration; daily train command accepts only a video and optional output path.
Acquire GPU lock before creating output; persist the original stage-specific exception; status is CPU-only.

behavior_contract.fitted_body_usage: fresh proposal extent and scale only

validation_scope: Local deployment evidence is in provenance/deployment119-validation.json; historical viewer compatibility remains separate.

behavior_differences: Remove unused top-level torch import only; all SH evaluation formulas and original BSD license retained.
CPU PLY transform checks no longer require installing PyTorch; tensor callers keep their original arithmetic.

new_modules.source: Original CPU engineering serializer for common 3DGS and COLMAP text formats
behavior: Preserves full fx/fy/cx/cy, OpenCV w2c, common-3DGS c2w orientation and camera centers.
Deterministic portable image basenames with collision handling and lossless original-name mapping.
COLMAP point file and per-image feature lines are empty; no fabricated points, tracks or source images.
CPU tests independently reproject serialized JSON/text cameras with off-center principal points and Hamilton quaternion decoding.
